note: Independent HEAD re-judgment against RFC 7606 Section 5.1: "An UPDATE message MUST NOT contain more than one of the following: non-empty Withdrawn Routes field, non-empty Network Layer Reachability Information field, MP_REACH_NLRI attribute, and MP_UNREACH_NLRI attribute." Read all eleven tagged units and producers (NLRIBearingFieldCount, MixesNLRIFields, SplitCompliant, writeOrdinaryUpdateBody). Positive tests cover the full 16-combination matrix (TestNLRIBearingFieldCountEveryCombination), parsed and wire splitting of fitting mixed UPDATEs (TestSplitCompliantSplitsMixedUpdateThatFits, TestSplitWireUpdateSplitsMixedShapeThatFits), egress override (TestEgressOverrideSplitsMixedShape), same/cross-context forwarding (TestForwardSplitsMixedShapeSameContextThatFits, TestForwardSplitsMixedShapeAcrossContextsThatFits), empty MP_UNREACH non-EoR preservation (TestSplitWireUpdateDoesNotManufactureEoR), and whole-daemon relay (test/plugin/rfc7606-relay-one-field.ci asserting exact withdraw-only frame seq=3 before announcement seq=4). Negative controls (TestSplitCompliantPassesThroughCompliantUpdate, TestForwardCompliantShapeKeepsZeroCopy, TestSplitWireUpdateCompliantShapeUntouched) assert object/pointer identity on compliant single-field UPDATEs. Changes since the prior audit (fwdPathOrigin, next-hop unchanged in .ci, CheckedWriteTo/flush in writeOrdinaryUpdateBody) preserved all splitting conditions and assertions. Source re-judgment only; no test or gate run claimed.
